requirement: On the manager/staff results review surface and the action notices, an organizer exclusion (request plus a second person's co-sign, with a recorded reason) is labelled 'Excluded (organizer decision)' and is never worded as a governing-body disqualification.
enforcement_point: Wording in the results review UI and action notices; behavior stays in the CF1 A5 database functions (migration 20270120094000), unchanged.

tests.name: the label is 'Excluded (organizer decision)' and is used for managers and everyone else
no user-facing exclusion surface says disqualified / DQ / disqualification (except the explicit disclaimer)

interpretation_notes: Scope is wording on the manager results surface and notices only. Not covered: the public results page lumps scratched, no-show and excluded couples as 'Not placed' (the public reader does not expose the kind); the separate distinctness of Scratch / No-show / Excluded / Disqualified and the reachability of the status 'disqualified' are tracked in OD20-DISQUALIFIED-STATUS-REACHABILITY. Regression snapshots of existing behavior are in the same test file but are not evidence that the wording changed nothing.
